features.quote: Model gets 8 tool calls per attempt max
15 max iterations per task before hard stop
After iteration 8, inject a hint: "You've tried N approaches. Consider whether the constraints are compatible."
Hard stop at iteration 15 or tool budget exhaustion
Cap transcript length at 80K tokens or split into episodes
features.justification_quote: Some models have context windows <100K; very long transcripts may truncate.

features.quote: Flag if any model shows signs of "learned helplessness" (gives up immediately after 2 failures).
Potential for misuse: Document if results could be weaponized
